scope: All 24 reports in the frozen 2003-2008 Benefits Council acquisition, joined to a committee-only filings inventory by beginning image number. Seven selected report PDFs plus two two-page FEC letters reviewed. Three reports have selected-field reviews and four have complete page inventories, including a Q1 follow-up of six itemized dates/amounts. This is not all historical filings or an independent financial audit.
projectionNotes: Native fields are minimum public metadata projections, not raw HTTP responses. Optional fields acquired with get() can collapse absent keys and null; do not infer schema absence from a null projection. No contributor identities are retained. The acquisition helper exhausted API pagination; query completeness does not establish historical completeness.

documents.label: 2006q1
documents.notes: Cover and summary headers end March 1, 2006; the next acquired report starts April 1. Full-packet follow-up finds six itemized transactions dated March 9-30, after the header end. This is an internal date conflict, not evidence of an unreported or zero-activity month. API values 3769.00 and 3778.00 omit cents present in the scan. Selected schedule totals reconcile with page 2 receipts and page 4 contributions/disbursements; this is not independent financial or coverage verification.

documents.label: 2008post-amendment
documents.notes: Printed page 4 has blank period contribution, independent-expenditure and total-disbursement cells. The 16721.22 in column B is year-to-date, not period spending. Only cover and disbursement-summary pages reviewed.

documents.label: 2008post-original
documents.notes: All seven downloaded PDF pages inspected to inventory the packet; no disbursement-summary page is present. The January 6, 2009 letter reports no contributions to candidates or PACs in the period. This is a reported no-contribution claim, not verification of zero total disbursements or independent expenditures. No contributor details are transcribed.

documents.label: 2008q3-amendment
documents.notes: Form 3X uses a different contribution definition. Receipt stamp is May 26, 2009, while the signature retains October 14, 2008. Column B is year-to-date, not an additional period amount.

documents.label: 2008q3-original
documents.notes: Form 3 line 18 labels transfers to other authorized committees, not Form 3X line 23 contributions. Equal amounts do not make these labels interchangeable. Cover and disbursement summary only reviewed.

documents.label: 2008ye-amendment
documents.notes: All seven downloaded PDF pages inspected to inventory the packet; no disbursement-summary page is present. PDF page 4 is Schedule A. Page 2 period disbursements is blank although cash arithmetic implies no reduction. This is not transcribed as an explicit zero. Pages 5-6 reproduce the May 15, 2009 FEC letter; they are not another enforcement event.

documents.label: 2008ye-original
documents.notes: All five downloaded PDF pages inspected to inventory the packet; no disbursement-summary page is present. PDF page 4 is a Schedule A receipt page, not printed Form 3 page 4.

formCorrectionLetter.notes: One letter references all three reports and requests Form 3X. Three FRQ inventory entries point to copies of this same-dated request. Only this standalone copy was fully visually reviewed; another copy is attached to the year-end amendment. No final enforcement disposition is established.

versionDecisionNotes: Use the filings endpoint most_recent only on the exact joined frozen report. Retain the reports endpoint is_amended. The three negative previous_file_number values are not joined to null original file_number values; matched periods, images and the form-correction letter support the paired review. API F3X classification does not override visible original Form 3 labels.

priorNotice.notes: Page 1 is an RQ-7 notice referring to the January 1-March 31 April Quarterly report, stating that the committee may have failed to file and requesting immediate filing. Page 2 is blank except its scan image number. The notice precedes the report's May 9 receipt and does not certify the later filing's coverage or correct its header.

periodConsistencyReviews.assessment: Internal date inconsistency confirmed at selected field scope; likely header error is an inference. Neither March 31 in the prior notice nor March 30 as the latest itemized date establishes a corrected reporting end. Six dated rows reconcile selected totals, not complete historical activity.
periodConsistencyReviews.notes: Only dates, amounts and page/slot/line locations are retained; no contributor or recipient names/addresses are transcribed. The interest receipt has no checked line-number box; no line 17 checkbox is inferred. Receipt reconciliation uses the clear page-2 line 6c value, not every receipt-summary cell. The taxes are a page-4 summary observation without a separately itemized tax row in this packet. Blank independent expenditures remain unknown, not zero.
